overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）、国际贸易（1 篇）。方法上以随机过程、回归分析为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、NBER（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: From Resources to Performance: How Social and Intellectual Capital Drive MSME Innovation
papers.venue: Shirkah Journal of Economics and Business
papers.abstract: Micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) operate under persistent resource constraints, making the effective mobilization of intangible resources increasingly important for sustaining business performance. This study examines how social capital and intellectual capital contribute to MSME performance and investigates whether innovation serves as a mechanism through which these resources are transformed into business outcomes. It also examines the role of managerial ability in strengthening the relationship between social capital and MSME performance. Drawing on Resource-Based Theory, the study employed a quantitative explanatory design involving 204 ultra-micro food and beverage entrepreneurs. Data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS. The findings demonstrate that social capital contributes to both innovation and MSME performance, while intellectual capital strengthens innovation and has a particularly important contribution to performance. Innovation also functions as a significant pathway linking both social capital and intellectual capital with MSME performance. Managerial ability contributes directly to performance but does not significantly moderate the social capital–performance relationship. These findings indicate that MSME performance depends not simply on possessing relational and knowledge-based resources, but on the capacity to mobilize and transform these resources through innovation and effective managerial action. The study extends the resource-based perspective by highlighting innovation as a critical resource-conversion mechanism in ultra-micro enterprises.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs）在长期资源受限的条件下运营，因此有效调动无形资源对于维持其业务绩效至关重要。本研究探讨了社会资本和智力资本如何促进MSME的绩效，并分析了创新是否作为将这些资源转化为业务成果的机制。同时，研究还考察了管理能力在加强社会资本与MSME绩效之间的关系中的作用。基于资源基础理论（Resource-Based Theory），本研究采用定量解释性设计方法，对204位超微型食品和饮料行业创业者进行了调查。数据通过SmartPLS软件进行偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析。研究结果表明，社会资本既有助于推动创新，也直接提升MSME的绩效；而智力资本不仅增强了创新能力，还对绩效有着尤为重要的贡献。此外，创新还成为连接社会资本、智力资本与MSME绩效的关键纽带。管理能力虽直接对绩效产生影响，但并未显著调节社会资本与绩效之间的关系。这些发现表明，MSME的绩效不仅仅取决于其是否拥有关系资本和知识资本，更取决于其能否通过创新及有效的管理行动来调动和转化这些资源。本研究通过强调创新在超微型企业中的关键资源转化作用，进一步拓展了资源基础理论的视角。。

papers.title: The Substantive Impact of the UK "Say on Pay" Regime on Executive Compensation Levels
papers.abstract: This paper examines the substantive impact of the UK “say on pay” regime on executive compensation levels. It first outlines the regime’s legislative development, dual-track information disclosure system and two-tier shareholder voting mechanism consisting of binding votes on remuneration policies and advisory votes on implementation reports. The study finds that the regime has failed to curb the sustained growth of total executive compensation, yet it has promoted the shift of pay structure towards a performance-oriented model and expanded the application of long-term incentive plans, while strong shareholder opposition can drive targeted pay adjustments in individual cases. The paper further attributes the limited effectiveness to internal corporate governance flaws, the non-binding nature of most voting outcomes and structural problems in shareholding. Finally, it puts forward targeted reform proposals, concluding that further institutional improvements are required to better align executive pay with corporate performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文探讨了英国“薪酬决策参与”制度对高管薪酬水平的实质性影响。首先，文章概述了该制度的立法发展过程、双轨信息披露体系以及由关于薪酬政策的具有约束力的投票和关于实施情况的咨询性投票组成的双层股东投票机制。研究发现，该制度未能有效遏制高管薪酬总额的持续增长，但促进了薪酬结构向绩效导向模式的转变，并扩大了长期激励计划的应用范围；同时，强烈的股东反对意见在个别情况下能够推动针对性的薪酬调整。文章进一步指出，其效果有限的原因在于企业内部治理结构的缺陷、大多数投票结果的非约束性以及股东持股结构存在的问题。最后，本文提出了针对性的改革建议，认为需要进一步完善相关制度，以使高管薪酬更好地与企业绩效相匹配。。

papers.title: When a Correct Reward Is Not Enough: Diagnosing and Guiding PPO in an Analytically Solved Broker-Trader Game
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used for financial optimal-control problems when complex dynamics make analytical strategies difficult to obtain. There are financial mathematics literactures which provides many solved models whose equations and controls could evaluate and guide learning; we ask whether RL can exploit these results.   We place a proximal policy optimisation (PPO) agent in an analytically solved continuous-time broker--trader game. PPO replaces the broker and chooses its trading speed while interacting with an informed trader and stochastic uninformed order flow. We derive a finite-step reward from the broker's continuous-time payoff and verify its discrete implementation through grid refinement and an exact one-step identity. With zero uninformed flow, a validation-selected PPO--FFNN approaches the reference action. With stochastic uninformed flow, the tested PPO--FFNN and PPO--LSTM remain inaccurate, although supervised learning confirms that their actors can represent the action. Monte Carlo diagnostics show that their critics do not reliably rank nearby actions; potential-based reward shaping also gives no reliable improvement. Under partial information, a causal certainty-equivalent controller based on the broker's observable history remains close to the reference, while PPO has larger errors and lower payoffs.   Finally, we freeze the analytical policy and train PPO to adjust it after the execution cost changes. Halving the cost yields a repeatable improvement that closes \(2.22\%\) of the gap to the changed-cost reference. The analytical solution therefore provides both a benchmark for diagnosing RL and a useful starting policy for adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】强化学习（RL）在金融最优控制问题中的应用日益增多，尤其是在系统动态复杂、难以通过分析方法制定策略的情况下。现有金融数学文献中提供了许多已解决的模型，这些模型的方程和控制策略可以为强化学习提供评估和指导。我们探讨了强化学习是否能够利用这些研究成果。我们将一种基于近端策略优化（PPO）的算法应用于一个已通过分析方法求解的连续时间经纪人-交易者博弈模型中：PPO在与知情交易者和随机产生的非知情订单流交互的过程中，自主决定交易速度。我们根据经纪人的连续时间收益推导出相应的奖励函数，并通过网格细化方法验证了该算法的离散实现形式。在非知情订单流为零的情况下，经过验证的PPO-FFNN算法能够接近最优解；而在存在随机非知情订单流的情况下，测试的PPO-FFNN和PPO-LSTM算法的预测效果仍然不够准确，尽管监督学习表明这些算法的代理模型能够正确表示交易行为。蒙特卡洛诊断结果显示，这些算法的评估机制无法可靠地对相近的交易策略进行排序；基于潜在价值的奖励调整方法也无法显著提升算法性能。在信息不完全的情况下，基于经纪人可观测历史数据的因果确定性等价控制器仍能保持与最优解的接近度，而PPO算法的误...。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、随机过程。

papers.title: PreFER: Interactive Robo-Advisor with Scoring Mechanism
papers.abstract: We propose an interactive robo-advising framework that learns personalized risk preferences from scores provided by clients. The resulting preference-learning problem is closely related to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL), as the robo-advisor infers the client's latent reward specification from feedback. The robo-advisor interacts with clients iteratively as follows. At each interaction time, the advisor generates investment advice based on the optimal policy distribution derived from an inferred personalized risk preference. The client scores the advice. The advisor updates its assessment of the client's risk preference based on the feedback. This learning procedure motivates us to investigate discrete-time Predictable Forward Exploratory Reward (PreFER) processes and derive an exploratory investment strategy. By interpreting the score as the acceptance probability of a piece of advice, our inverse learning procedure learns the client's exploratory investment distribution using the acceptance-rejection method pioneered by von Neumann. Under CARA preferences, we show that, even though the scores contain noise, the robo-advisor can identify the client's current risk aversion after a sufficiently large number of interactions. The PreFER process then carries the learned preference forward and generates future recommendations under updated market conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 📌 研究问题：本文提出了一种交互式智能投顾框架，旨在解决如何从客户的反馈评分中推断其个性化风险偏好的问题。

papers.title: Inference for Regression with Clustered or Spatially Correlated Data I: Framework and Clustering
papers.abstract:
Many regression analyses use observations that are correlated within uncorrelated clusters and/or are correlated in distance or other spatial measure. Such data are often positively correlated. This reduces the information content of an additional observation compared to the default of independent observations. Consequently, failure to adjust standard errors for such correlation leads to confidence intervals that are too narrow, and to hypothesis tests that over reject.
In this paper we first provide a general framework. We then focus on inference when observations are correlated within cluster and uncorrelated across clusters. We detail cluster-robust inference methods, particularly methods that provide improved finite-sample performance when there is not a large number of clusters. Such adjustments are often necessary.
A companion paper, Cameron and Miller (2026), presents inference when correlation is spatially dampening in the distance between observations. The two papers are intended to provide a guide to empirical researchers.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】许多回归分析使用的观测数据在相互独立的簇内存在相关性，或者在距离或其他空间度量上存在相关性。这类数据通常呈正相关。与独立观测数据相比，这种相关性会降低额外观测数据的信息含量。因此，如果不调整标准误差以考虑这种相关性，会导致置信区间过窄，从而使得假设检验更容易得出错误结论（即过度拒绝原假设）。

在本文中，我们首先提出了一个通用框架。接着，我们重点讨论了当观测数据在簇内相关而在簇间不相关时的推断方法。我们详细介绍了具有簇鲁棒性的推断方法，特别是那些在簇数量不多时仍能提高有限样本性能的方法。这类调整通常是必要的。

另一篇配套论文（Cameron和Miller，2026年）探讨了当观测数据之间的相关性随距离增加而减弱时的推断问题。这两篇论文旨在为实证研究者提供指导。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Inference for Regression with Clustered or Spatially Correlated Data II: Spatial Correlation
papers.abstract:
This article presents inference for regression with data that are correlated across some measure of distance; most often geographic distance. Failure to appropriately adjust standard errors can lead to confidence intervals that are too narrow, and hypothesis tests that over-reject.
If spatial correlation exists within region but not across regions then one can use cluster-robust inference methods presented in the companion paper, Cameron and Miller (2026).
In this paper we focus on methods when spatial correlation is dampening in distance. Then the standard inference method is the spatial HAC of Conley (1999). This method does not work well when spatial persistence is high, and alternative inference methods are needed. Additionally it is important that regression models control for any spatial trends to avoid finding spurious correlation.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】本文探讨了在数据存在某种距离相关性（最常见的是地理距离相关性）的情况下进行回归分析的推断方法。如果未能适当调整标准误差，可能会导致置信区间过窄，以及假设检验结果出现过度拒绝（即错误地拒绝原假设）的情况。  
如果空间相关性仅存在于某个区域内而非不同区域之间，那么可以使用Cameron和Miller（2026年）论文中提出的群集鲁棒推断方法。  
在本文中，我们重点讨论了当空间相关性随距离增加而减弱时的推断方法。在这种情况下，标准的推断方法是Conley（1999年）提出的空间HAC（Hierarchical Autoregressive with Covariates）方法。然而，当空间持续性较高时，该方法的效果不佳，需要采用其他替代推断方法。此外，回归模型必须控制任何空间趋势，以避免出现虚假的相关性。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: The circular economy, explained by AI
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Research on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the circular economy (CE) has largely examined how AI can improve circular operations. Much less attention has been paid to AI tools widely used to understand and reason about the CE, particularly large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT. Researchers, practitioners, students, and decision-makers use these tools to seek explanations and support reasoning about circularity. This paper examines what is at stake when LLM-generated accounts enter CE inquiry. As a conceptual contribution, it develops a framework for analysing how AI-supported CE knowledge is formed, how it may influence action, and what ethical implications follow. The Content dimension concerns the construction and credibility of CE knowledge, focusing on pattern-based generation, opaque and heterogeneous sources, and fragmentation within CE scholarship. The Transformative dimension considers how such knowledge may influence innovation and entrepreneurship, including whether familiar, optimisation-oriented approaches overshadow systemic alternatives. The Moral dimension addresses the risks of relying on LLM outputs, including operational indifference to truth, AI assertiveness, the absence of moral agency, and the need for human judgement and accountability. The paper argues that LLMs can widen access to CE knowledge and support inquiry, but cannot independently determine which interpretations are better supported, exercise the judgement required to challenge linear assumptions, or decide how environmental, social, and economic values should be balanced. It identifies governance priorities concerning transparency, expert scrutiny, human agency, and epistemic humility. The framework can also guide future empirical research on how LLM-generated accounts vary across models, prompts, languages, and user contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
关于人工智能（AI）与循环经济（CE）的研究主要探讨了AI如何提升循环经济的运作效率。然而，对于那些被广泛用于理解和分析循环经济的AI工具（尤其是大型语言模型，如ChatGPT）的关注却相对较少。研究人员、实践者、学生和决策者利用这些工具来寻求对循环经济相关问题的解释和支持性论据。本文分析了当由大型语言模型生成的内容被纳入循环经济研究时所涉及的关键问题。作为一项概念性贡献，本文构建了一个分析框架，用于探讨AI支持的循环经济知识是如何形成的、它可能如何影响实际行动，以及由此产生的伦理后果。  

在“内容维度”中，本文关注循环经济知识的构建过程及其可信度，重点讨论了基于模式的生成方式、信息来源的不透明性和多样性，以及循环经济学术研究中的碎片化现象。在“转型维度”中，本文分析了这类知识对创新和创业活动的可能影响，包括传统的、以优化为导向的方法是否可能掩盖了更系统的解决方案。在“道德维度”中，本文指出了依赖大型语言模型输出所带来的风险，如对事实的漠视、AI的“强势态度”、缺乏道德主体性，以及人类判断和责任的重要性。本文认为，大型语言模型确实能够扩大人们对循环经济知识的获取范围...。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Experts for Cryptocurrency Order Execution: Training Stability, Tail Risk, and Failure Modes
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement-learning policies for order execution can vary substantially across training seeds, so apparent architectural gains may reflect favourable training realisations rather than reproducible properties of the architecture. We evaluate vanilla Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQL), K-means-partitioned mixtures of DDQL experts at $K \in \{2, 4, 8\}$, and dense networks parameter-matched to the $K{=}4$ and $K{=}8$ expert budgets on 5-minute mean-aggregated BTC/USDT limit order book data from Binance. No learned configuration significantly improves mean implementation shortfall over DDQL. Under the reported specification, all have higher mean shortfall than TWAP (0.39 bps) and immediate liquidation (0.21 bps) in an environment whose frictionless replay and terminal-urgency penalty make early liquidation nearly costless; 11/100 vanilla-DDQL runs, versus none in either MoE $K{\geq}4$ arm, converge to a policy that waits until forced liquidation. We then decompose this specification on a device-matched baseline. Annealed exploration alone eliminates observed collapses (12/100 to 0/100; exact McNemar $p{=}4.9{\times}10^{-4}$), matching the elimination under expert partitioning. Combining annealed exploration with the aligned reward restores collapse in 19/30 runs; with all three specification changes, it rises to 48/100. In this environment, expert partitioning is unnecessary to suppress collapse and appears to mask a training-specification failure rather than confer an intrinsic performance benefit. No MoE $K{=}8$ run collapses under any of the six specifications tested. Across-seed dispersion is lowest at $K{=}8$ but non-monotone and not robust to family-wise adjustment, while within-policy tail risk worsens monotonically with $K$. The apparent attribution of the failure mode reverses between 30 and 100 seeds, illustrating the importance of repeated-seed evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】深度强化学习策略在用于订单执行时，其性能可能会因训练种子（training seeds）的不同而产生显著差异。因此，某些看似显著的架构改进可能实际上只是由于特定的训练环境带来的良好结果，而非该架构本身所具备的可复现性能。我们评估了基本的Double Deep Q-Learning（DDQL）算法、采用K-means方法对DDQL专家模型进行分区的混合策略（其中K取值为2、4或8），以及与K=4和K=8的专家模型参数相匹配的密集网络模型。这些模型均使用了来自Binance平台的5分钟平均聚合BTC/USDT限价订单簿数据进行了测试。结果表明，没有任何一种学习到的配置能够显著改善DDQL算法的平均执行偏差。在所测试的条件下，所有这些算法的平均执行偏差均高于TWAP（0.39 bps）和即时清算策略（0.21 bps）；在该环境中，由于无摩擦的重放机制以及终端紧急性惩罚的存在，提前清算几乎不会带来额外成本。在100次DDQL算法运行中，仅有11次能够收敛到一种等待强制清算的策略；而在所有K≥4的混合策略（MoE）实验中，这种情况并未发生。随后，我们将这一实验结果与基于设备配置的基线结果...。

papers.title: No Women No Innovation? The Effect of Women on Boards on Hard and Soft Innovation in SMEs
papers.abstract: The role of women on corporate boards and its impact on innovation remains heavily debated. While existing literature offers conflicting perspectives on whether female board representation spurs or hinders innovaiton, most research has focused exlusively on large firms. This studt adresses this gap by investigating the causal impact of women on boards on both "hard" (technological) and "soft" (non-technological) innovation within SMEs. Using a longitudinal dataset f 2762 Italian innovative SMEs from 2015 to 2024 and a 2SLS identification strategy, we find highly nuanced patterns. For hard innovation, the instrumented model reveals a robust positive causal impacr, reversing a negative baseline coefficient and exposing a severe negative selection bias. For soft innovation, a stable positive impact is confirmed. Our findings provide crucial causal evidence for SMEs' governance, while offering tailored insights for policymakers and practitioners to incentivize women' management roles in SMES.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】女性在企业董事会中的角色及其对创新的影响仍存在广泛争议。尽管现有文献对于女性董事比例是促进还是阻碍创新持有不同观点，但大多数研究仅关注大型企业。本研究通过探讨女性董事对中小企业（SMEs）中“硬性”（技术）和“软性”（非技术）创新的因果影响，填补了这一研究空白。利用2015年至2024年间2762家意大利创新型中小企业的纵向数据集以及双重差分法（2SLS）识别技术，我们发现了较为复杂的规律：在硬性创新方面，研究模型显示了显著的正面因果效应，这逆转了基线分析中的负面结论，并揭示了严重的负面选择偏差；而在软性创新方面，仍然确认了女性董事的积极影响。我们的发现为中小企业治理提供了重要的因果证据，同时也为政策制定者和实践者提供了具体建议，以鼓励女性在中小企业中担任管理职务。。研究方法：两阶段最小二乘。

papers.title: FinNextAssist: Towards Professional Financial Deep Research Assistant
papers.abstract: Deep Research (DR) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex, research-oriented tasks through autonomous planning, iterative retrieval, multi-step reasoning, and structured reporting. However, adapting DR agents to finance introduces unique challenges: financial analysis demands the joint completion of heterogeneous sub-tasks spanning diverse data types, tools, and analytical workflows. We identify three key requirements for a professional financial DR agent: integration of authoritative, heterogeneous financial data sources; specialized analytical tools and skills; and dedicated sub-agents for domain-specific sub-tasks. Building on these principles, we propose FinNextAssist, an end-to-end deep research framework designed for professional financial analysis. FinNextAssist decomposes the research process into four stages: Task Planner, Evidence Compiler, Reasoning Engine, and Report Assembler, and introduces two novel lightweight sub-agents: TabAgent, for cross-market financial table understanding, and HeteroAgent, for cross-modality heterogeneous financial data interpretation. Extensive experiments on FinDeepResearch, the Finance Agent Benchmark, and FinTMMBench-Web show that FinNextAssist substantially outperforms both strong proprietary and open-source DR agents, with ablation studies confirming the contribution of each component across diverse markets and languages.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】深度研究（Deep Research, DR）代理在复杂的、以研究为导向的任务中展现了强大的能力，这得益于其自主规划、迭代检索、多步推理以及结构化报告等功能。然而，将DR代理应用于金融领域会带来独特的挑战：金融分析需要同时处理涉及多种数据类型、工具和分析工作流程的异构子任务。我们提出了专业金融深度研究代理的三个关键要求：整合权威的、异构的金融数据源；配备专门的分析工具和技能；以及为特定领域子任务配备专门的子代理。基于这些原则，我们设计了FinNextAssist这一端到端的深度研究框架，专为专业金融分析而设计。FinNextAssist将研究过程划分为四个阶段：任务规划器（Task Planner）、证据编译器（Evidence Compiler）、推理引擎（Reasoning Engine）和报告组装器（Report Assembler），并引入了两个新型轻量级子代理：TabAgent（用于跨市场金融表格理解）和HeteroAgent（用于跨模态的异构金融数据解读）。在FinDeepResearch、Finance Agent Benchmark以及FinTMMBench-We...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Landscape-Dependent Performance of Photonic Quantum Solvers in QUBO Feature Selection for Financial Risk Detection
papers.abstract: Feature selection for imbalanced classification tasks such as credit card fraud and consumer default detection requires balancing predictive relevance, inter-feature redundancy, and computational feasibility. We benchmark three computing paradigms, classical branch-and-bound optimization (Gurobi), photonic entropy computing (QCI Dirac-3), and simulated photonic boson sampling (Piquasso), across thirteen feature-selection methods on two datasets: ULB Credit Card Fraud (30 features) and AmEx consumer default (159 features). Each method is routed to the solver matched to its mathematical structure. On ULB, Dirac-3 MI-Spearman matches the all-features model using 13 of 30 features (mean F1 0.873 +/- 0.023 over five runs, best run 0.896), and Piquasso is the best method at k=5. On AmEx, performance rises steadily with the feature budget and every paradigm approaches F1 = 0.80 only near the full feature set. Most differences between Gurobi and Dirac-3 on identical methods fall within run-to-run variation; the large gaps occur where the certified optimum generalizes poorly, most sharply for distance correlation on AmEx at k=25 (Gurobi F1 = 0.422 vs. a Dirac-3 mean of 0.746). At matched budgets, F1 varies about ten times more across methods on ULB than on AmEx, which we trace to how concentrated the predictive signal is in each feature space.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】在处理不平衡分类任务（如信用卡欺诈和消费者违约检测）时，特征选择需要兼顾预测相关性、特征间的冗余性以及计算的可行性。我们对比了三种计算范式：传统的分支定界优化算法（Gurobi）、光子熵计算方法（QCI Dirac-3）以及模拟光子玻色子采样方法（Piquasso），并在两个数据集上测试了这三种范式下的十三种特征选择算法：ULB信用卡欺诈数据集（包含30个特征）和AmEx消费者违约数据集（包含159个特征）。每种算法都被匹配到与其数学结构相匹配的求解器上。在ULB数据集上，QCI Dirac-3使用30个特征中的13个特征时，其性能与全特征模型的F1分数相当（平均F1值为0.873 ± 0.023，五次实验中最佳值为0.896）；而在k=5时，Piquasso成为表现最好的方法。在AmEx数据集上，随着特征数量的增加，算法性能稳步提升，但所有范式的F1分数都仅在包含全部特征时才能接近0.80。Gurobi与QCI Dirac-3在相同算法上的性能差异主要源于实验间的随机性；而在某些情况下（尤其是AmEx数据集的k=25时），两种方法的性能差距显著（Gurobi的F1值为0.422...。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Uniqueness of Recursive Utility with Unbounded Consumption and Non-Expected Utility
papers.abstract: We derive sufficient conditions for the existence, non-existence, uniqueness and global attractivity of stochastic recursive utilities. Our approach uses abstract order-theoretic fixed-point arguments, allowing us to accommodate a large class of Markov consumption-growth models with unbounded per-period consumption and a broad range of recursive preferences, including non-expected utility specifications. We illustrate the usefulness of the framework through macro-finance applications to widely used consumption-growth models under several preference specifications, including Epstein--Zin preferences, multiple priors, smooth ambiguity, and Hansen--Sargent robust-control preferences. In each application, our general conditions reduce to a simple, economically interpretable parameter test that shows how fundamental parameters influence existence and uniqueness. While uniqueness of recursive utility can be difficult to guarantee in unbounded environments, in a Markov setting with non-unit elasticity we establish uniqueness within the class of recursive utilities having a so-called separability property.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们推导出了随机递归效用函数存在性、不存在性、唯一性以及全局吸引性的充分条件。我们的方法采用了抽象的序理论不动点论证，从而能够涵盖一大类具有无界逐期消费行为的马尔可夫消费-增长模型，并涵盖了广泛的递归偏好类型，包括非预期效用函数形式。通过将这一框架应用于多种偏好设定下的常用消费-增长模型（如Epstein-Zin偏好模型、多重先验模型、平滑模糊偏好模型以及Hansen-Sargent鲁棒控制偏好模型），我们展示了该框架的实用性。在每个应用案例中，我们的通用条件都被简化为一个简单且具有经济解释意义的参数检验，该检验揭示了基本参数如何影响随机递归效用函数的存在性和唯一性。尽管在无界环境中难以保证递归效用函数的唯一性，但在具有非单位弹性的马尔可夫模型中，我们证明了在具备所谓“可分离性”性质的递归效用函数类别内，其唯一性是成立的。。研究方法：随机过程。
